question: does the crossing -- guidance above the oracle-selected best-of-N frontier at its own budget -- replicate on a second, independent molecular generator?

prereg_lock.note: Frozen before any C31 measurement artefact existed -- before the Stage 0 feasibility run, not only before the decision stage.  The block from '## C31.0.1 Why this experiment exists' onward is copied verbatim into reports/section_c31_second_generator.md; tests/test_second_generator.py asserts the copy is byte-identical and that this file's mtime strictly precedes every C31 artefact.

generator.comparison_generator: ibm-research/GP-MoLFormer-Uniq, linear attention, 46.8M params -- every C23-C30 number

accounting: processed generator tokens (actual); full_recompute also reported
uncertainty: per-seed values and a seed-level t interval on 2 df (t_0.975,2 = 4.302653); no bootstrap anywhere in C31, see C31.0.5

G1.rule: cached candidate states equal full-prefix recomputation at every probe point to within 2e-03 absolute (C24's tolerance, reused)
G1.note: Not bit-identical, and not claimed to be: standard attention reduces in a different order on the cached and the full-recompute paths.  The molecular linear-attention backends are bit-identical; this one is not, and C24 found the same on GPT-2 for text.

G5.rule: the target interval must be an exact union of binner bins, and the binner's top category must sit strictly above the target value (C31.0.3 G5)

G6.rule: no molecule's prefixes straddle train and test, and the frozen artefacts are hashed at write time (C31.0.3 G6)

G2.rule: the guided sampling distribution computed from cached candidate states equals the one computed from full-prefix recomputation: max abs probability difference <= 1e-03 and argmax identical on >= 99.5% of prefixes (C31.0.3 G2)

G3.rule: one cell decoded under both backends: |delta hit rate| <= 0.05 and |delta tokens per molecule under full-recompute accounting| / value <= 0.02 (C31.0.3 G3).  Reported as a residual; does not block.
G3.note: Exact equality is NOT required and is not claimed: G1 shows the two paths differ at ~1e-3 in the candidate state, so a sampled trajectory can diverge.  The `actual` token counts differ BY DESIGN -- that is what the two accounting rules measure -- so the comparison is made under the full-recompute rule, which both backends should agree on.

G4.rule: processed_tokens_actual mod (k + 1) == 0 in every guidance cell and every generation seed (C31.0.3 G4)

mid_probe_point.rule: C31.0.4: argmax over probe points 1..11 of held-out VALIDATION target AUROC averaged over the three head seeds; ties to the lower index. Selected by prediction, in advance, never by steering outcome.

D1.rule: the crossing replicates: >= 1 cell crosses at k in {2,4}

D2.rule: the crossing is at the cheap end: every crossing cell has k <= 4

D3.rule: no compute knob: hit rate at k=32 minus k=2 is <= +0.02 on every arm

D4.rule: the depth curve replicates: for both required properties the probe point maximising held-out TEST target AUROC is strictly less than 12

D5.rule: the crossing does not replicate: no cell crosses at any k

D6.rule: the deployed configuration replicates: the deployed arm (final probe point, lambda = 1) crosses at k = 2

D7.rule: the honesty rule: every cell whose between-generation-seed sd exceeds its own mean advantage is reported as NOT RESOLVED at three generation seeds

P3.statement: the depth curve peaks strictly before probe point 12 for both required properties (D4 fires)

P4.statement: the selected mid probe point M is in [3, 8] for both required properties

P5.statement: the frozen-state head beats the trivial prefix-statistics baseline on held-out test target AUROC by >= 0.02 at its best probe point, for both required properties

P6.statement: D1 fires: at least one cell crosses at k in {2,4}

P7.statement: D6 fires: the deployed arm crosses at k = 2

P8.statement: D3 fires: hit rate at k=32 minus k=2 is <= +0.02 on every arm

P9.statement: qed does not cross at any k, on either arm

P10.statement: guidance mean validity at k = 2 stays >= 0.95 on every arm

P11.statement: the oracle-selected best-of-N curve is monotone non-decreasing in N on the measured grid for every property
